literal: In the fourth month of summer, on day jiaxu, Tang sent envoys on a friendly visit, bearing a letter from Renhuang Prince Bei.
idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month, on jiaxu day, Tang sent envoys on a courtesy mission, carrying a letter from Renhuang Prince Bei.

literal: On day jimao, the Jurchen came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On jimao day the Jurchen brought tribute.

literal: On the renwu new moon of the fifth month, he went to Zuzhou and paid respects at Emperor Taizu's tomb.
idiomatic: On the renwu new moon of the fifth month he traveled to Zuzhou and visited Emperor Taizu's tomb.

literal: In the sixth month, on day wuchen, he personally composed the inscription for Emperor Taizu's Founding of the State stele.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuchen day, he composed in his own hand the text for the stele commemorating Emperor Taizu's founding of the state.

literal: On day wuyin, the Wugu and Dielie tribes came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On wuyin day the Wugu and Dielie came with tribute.

literal: On day gengchen, he watched sumo wrestling.
idiomatic: On gengchen day he watched sumo bouts.

literal: On the xinsi new moon of the seventh month of autumn, gifts were distributed to officials within and without the court, each in due measure.
idiomatic: On the xinsi new moon of the seventh autumn month, officials inside and outside the court received gifts in varying measure.

literal: On day guiwei, cloth and silk were granted to the aged.
idiomatic: On guiwei day cloth and silk were bestowed on the elderly.

literal: On day bingxu, he summoned ministers and elders to discuss state affairs.
idiomatic: On bingxu day he called ministers and elders together to discuss government.

literal: On day renchen, Tang sent envoys presenting a red-tooth bamboo flute.
idiomatic: On renchen day Tang sent envoys bearing a red-tooth bamboo flute.

literal: On day guisi, the envoys came again, fearing retaliation for the campaign at Dingzhou.
idiomatic: On guisi day the envoys returned, anxious over how to answer for the affair at Dingzhou.

literal: On day renyin, Zhao Dejun, military governor of Tang's Lulong Army, sent men presenting seasonal fruits.
idiomatic: On renyin day Zhao Dejun, Tang's governor of the Lulong Army, sent men with seasonal fruits.

literal: On day dingwei, the new grain harvest was offered at Emperor Taizu's temple.
idiomatic: On dingwei day the first fruits of the harvest were offered at Emperor Taizu's temple.

literal: On day renxu in the eighth month, geese were being caught at Lake Yanliu when a violent storm suddenly arrived; boats capsized and more than sixty drowned. He ordered their families cared for and took the event as a warning.
idiomatic: On renxu day in the eighth month, while geese were being taken on Lake Yanliu, a sudden tempest struck; boats overturned and more than sixty men drowned. He ordered their families relieved and marked the disaster as a warning.

literal: On day wuchen, Linya Dilbi escaped custody; recaptured and interrogated, it was learned the matter had been a false accusation, and he was released.
idiomatic: On wuchen day Linya Dilbi broke free; seized again and questioned, it turned out the whole affair had been a frame-up, and he was set free.

literal: On day gengzi in the ninth month, the Zubu came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On gengzi day in the ninth month the Zubu brought tribute.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on day yimao, Tang sent envoys on a friendly visit.
idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, on yimao day, Tang sent envoys on a courtesy mission.

literal: On day jisi, envoys were dispatched to Yunzhong.
idiomatic: On jisi day envoys were sent to Yunzhong.

literal: In the eleventh month, on day dinghai, envoys were sent to convey greetings to the Huoli kingdom.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dinghai day, envoys were dispatched to inquire after the Huoli kingdom.

literal: On day dingwei, the Zubu presented thirty strings of Eastern Sea green goshawks.
idiomatic: On dingwei day the Zubu presented thirty strings of Eastern Sea green goshawks.

literal: In the twelfth month, on day xinhai, the households of the rebel Nili Gun were divided up and bestowed on the ministers.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinhai day, the families of the rebel Nili Gun were divided among the ministers as gifts.

literal: On day dingsi, he went west to hunt and halted at Pingdi Songlin.
idiomatic: On dingsi day he hunted westward and encamped at Pingdi Pine Forest.

literal: The eighth year of Tianxian.
idiomatic: The eighth year of Tianxian.

literal: In the first month of spring in the eighth year, on day wuzi, the Jurchen came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: In the eighth year, in the first spring month, on wuzi day, the Jurchen brought tribute.

literal: On day gengzi, the imperial younger brother Li Hu and Left Weiwu Guard senior general Sagie were ordered to lead troops against the Tangut.
idiomatic: On gengzi day the imperial younger brother Li Hu and Sagie, senior general of the Left Weiwu Guard, were ordered to march against the Tangut.

literal: On day guimao, the Emperor personally saw them off with a farewell feast.
idiomatic: On guimao day the Emperor personally saw them off with a farewell feast.

literal: On day xinhai in the second month, the Tuyuhun and Zubu came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On xinhai day in the second month the Tuyuhun and Zubu came with tribute.

literal: On day yimao, Kelu, envoy to Tang, returned; the tribute gifts he brought were divided among the ministers.
idiomatic: On yimao day Kelu, envoy to Tang, came back; the gifts he had brought were divided among the ministers.

literal: On day xinmao in the third month, the imperial younger brother returned victorious from campaigning against the Tangut; a feast was held to reward him.
idiomatic: On xinmao day in the third month the imperial younger brother returned victorious from the Tangut campaign, and a feast was held to honor him.

literal: On day bingshen, Tang sent envoys requesting that the campaign against the Tangut be halted; the Emperor replied that the battle had been won and the Tangut had already submitted.
idiomatic: On bingshen day Tang sent envoys asking that the Tangut campaign be stopped; the Emperor answered that the war was already won and the Tangut had submitted.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, on day wuwu, the Tangut came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month, on wuwu day, the Tangut brought tribute.

literal: On day jichou in the fifth month, he hunted at Mount Duniu; the imperial stud chestnut horse ridden by Tiyin Dielian died, and the mountain was accordingly named Mount Liu.
idiomatic: On jichou day in the fifth month he hunted at Mount Duniu; the chestnut stallion from the inner stud that Tiyin Dielian was riding died, and the mountain was named Mount Liu in its honor.

literal: On day wuxu, he went to Lake Yanliu.
idiomatic: On wuxu day he went to Lake Yanliu.

literal: On day jiayin in the sixth month, the Zubu came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On jiayin day in the sixth month the Zubu brought tribute.

literal: On day jiazi, the Uighur chieftain Aslan came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On jiazi day the Uighur chieftain Aslan came with tribute.

literal: On day wuyin in the seventh month of autumn, the empress-installation ceremony was performed.
idiomatic: On wuyin day in the seventh autumn month the empress-installation rites were performed.

literal: On day guiwei, the prince Tiligu was born.
idiomatic: On guiwei day Prince Tiligu was born.

literal: On day dinghai, the Iron Li, Jurchen, and Zubu came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On dinghai day the Iron Li, Jurchen, and Zubu all brought tribute.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on day yisi, the Zubu came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, on yisi day, the Zubu came with tribute.

literal: On day bingwu, he returned from Lake Yanliu.
idiomatic: On bingwu day he returned from Lake Yanliu.

literal: On day xinhai, Tang sent envoys on a friendly visit.
idiomatic: On xinhai day Tang sent envoys on a courtesy mission.

literal: On day jiwei, Bala was dispatched as envoy to Tang.
idiomatic: On jiwei day Bala was sent as envoy to Tang.

literal: On day xinwei, the Wugu chieftain Tulunmo came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On xinwei day the Wugu chieftain Tulunmo came with tribute.

literal: On day xinchou in the eleventh month, the Grand Empress Dowager died; envoys were sent to announce the mourning to Tang and to Renhuang Prince Bei.
idiomatic: On xinchou day in the eleventh month the Grand Empress Dowager died; envoys were dispatched to announce the mourning to Tang and to Renhuang Prince Bei.

literal: That month, Tang's emperor Siyuan died; his son Conghou succeeded him.
idiomatic: That same month Tang's emperor Siyuan died, and his son Conghou took the throne.

literal: On day dingmao in the twelfth month, the Tangut came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On dingmao day in the twelfth month the Tangut brought tribute.

literal: The ninth year of Tianxian.
idiomatic: The ninth year of Tianxian.

literal: In the first month of spring in the ninth year, on day guiyou, he fished on the Tu River.
idiomatic: In the ninth year, in the first spring month, on guiyou day, he fished on the Tu River.

literal: On day bingshen, the Tangut presented camels and deer.
idiomatic: On bingshen day the Tangut presented camels and deer.

literal: On day jihai, Nanjing presented a white roe deer.
idiomatic: On jihai day Nanjing presented a white roe deer.

literal: On day wuwu in the intercalary month, Tang sent envoys announcing mourning; the same day envoys were dispatched to offer condolences and sacrifice.
idiomatic: On wuwu day in the intercalary month Tang sent envoys announcing mourning, and that same day envoys were sent out to offer condolences and sacrifice.

literal: On day renxu, he proceeded east on tour.
idiomatic: On renxu day he set out on an eastern tour.

literal: The Jurchen came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: The Jurchen brought tribute.

literal: On day renshen in the second month, he offered sacrifice at Mount Muye.
idiomatic: On renshen day in the second month he sacrificed at Mount Muye.

literal: On day wuyin, the Grand Empress Dowager was buried at Deling tomb.
idiomatic: On wuyin day the Grand Empress Dowager was buried at Deling.

literal: Two days earlier, the funeral procession departed from the Cao Tu Hall; the Emperor wore mourning garb to escort her.
idiomatic: Two days before, the funeral cortege had set out from the Cao Tu Hall, and the Emperor went in full mourning to see her off.

literal: Later she was posthumously honored as Empress Xuanjian; an edict ordered a stele erected at the tomb.
idiomatic: Later she was given the posthumous title Empress Xuanjian, and an edict ordered a stele raised at the tomb.

literal: On day guimao in the third month, the Jurchen came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On guimao day in the third month the Jurchen brought tribute.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, Li Congke of Tang killed his sovereign and installed himself.
idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month, Li Congke of Tang murdered his lord and seized the throne.

literal: Renhuang Prince Bei sent a letter from Tang requesting permission to campaign against him.
idiomatic: From Tang, Renhuang Prince Bei sent a letter asking leave to march against him.

literal: On day jiachen in the fifth month, he went to Lake Yanliu.
idiomatic: On jiachen day in the fifth month he went to Lake Yanliu.

literal: On day guichou, the Jurchen came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On guichou day the Jurchen brought tribute.

literal: A great star fell during daylight.
idiomatic: A great star fell in broad daylight.

literal: On the jisi new moon in the sixth month, the Biegude came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On the jisi new moon of the sixth month the Biegude came with tribute.

literal: On day xinwei, the envoys sent by Tang's Li Conghou to thank him for the condolence mission first arrived at court.
idiomatic: On xinwei day the envoys Li Conghou of Tang had sent to thank the court for its condolence mission first arrived at the capital.

literal: On day renwu in the eighth month of autumn, he personally led a southern campaign.
idiomatic: On renwu day in the eighth autumn month he took the field in person on a southern campaign.

literal: On day yiyou, Zhaila Jieli caught a flying goose in his hand; the Emperor marveled at it and used it in sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.
idiomatic: On yiyou day Zhaila Jieli caught a flying goose in his bare hand; the Emperor took it for a marvel and offered it in sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

literal: On day gengzi in the ninth month, stars fell like rain in the southwest.
idiomatic: On gengzi day in the ninth month stars rained down in the southwest.

literal: On day yimao, he halted at Yun Prefecture.
idiomatic: On yimao day he encamped at Yun Prefecture.

literal: On day dingsi, Heyin was taken.
idiomatic: On dingsi day Heyin was captured.

literal: On day dinghai in the tenth month of winter, he overran Lingqiu; local elders brought cattle and wine to reward the army.
idiomatic: That winter, on dinghai day in the tenth month, he overran Lingqiu, and local elders brought cattle and wine to feast the army.

literal: On day xinchou in the eleventh month, he besieged Yangcheng in Wu Prefecture.
idiomatic: On xinchou day in the eleventh month he besieged Yangcheng in Wu Prefecture.

literal: On day renyin, Yangcheng surrendered.
idiomatic: On renyin day Yangcheng surrendered.

literal: On day guimao, Wazhi City surrendered; able-bodied men among the captives were registered for military service.
idiomatic: On guimao day Wazhi City surrendered; able-bodied men among the captives were enrolled in the army.

literal: On day renchen in the twelfth month, the prince Abo Sageli was born; the Empress fell ill.
idiomatic: On renchen day in the twelfth month Prince Abo Sageli was born, and the Empress fell ill.

literal: That month he halted southwest of Baihu Lake.
idiomatic: That month he encamped southwest of Baihu Lake.

literal: The tenth year of Tianxian.
idiomatic: The tenth year of Tianxian.

literal: In the first month of spring in the tenth year, on day wushen, the Empress died at the temporary palace.
idiomatic: In the tenth year, in the first spring month, on wushen day, the Empress died at the traveling palace.

literal: On day wuyin in the second month, the officials requested a posthumous title be added; he did not consent.
idiomatic: On wuyin day in the second month the officials asked that a posthumous title be added, but he refused.

literal: On day xinsi, Chancellor Nieli Gun plotted to flee south; the affair was discovered and he was arrested.
idiomatic: On xinsi day Chancellor Nieli Gun plotted to flee south; the plot came to light and he was seized.

literal: On day wuwu in the third month, the Tangut came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On wuwu day in the third month the Tangut brought tribute.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, Tuyuhun chieftain Tuiyude led his people in submitting to Liao rule.
idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month, the Tuyuhun chieftain Tuiyude led his people in submitting to the court.

literal: On day bingxu, two clans — the Empress Dowager's father's kin and the clan of her mother's former husband — were both made imperial uncles-in-law; Xiao Miansi was appointed Shangfu to head them.
idiomatic: On bingxu day two clans — the Empress Dowager's father's line and the clan of her mother's former husband — were both made imperial uncles-in-law, with Xiao Miansi appointed Shangfu to lead them.

literal: On day jichou, prisoners were reviewed.
idiomatic: On jichou day prisoners were reviewed.

literal: On the jiawu new moon of the fifth month, he first donned mourning garb and observed the empress's funeral rites.
idiomatic: On the jiawu new moon of the fifth month he first put on mourning dress and began the empress's funeral observances.

literal: On day bingwu, she was buried at Fengling.
idiomatic: On bingwu day she was buried at Fengling.

literal: The Emperor personally composed the epitaph; she was posthumously titled Empress of Manifest Virtue.
idiomatic: The Emperor wrote the epitaph himself; she was posthumously styled Empress of Manifest Virtue.

literal: On day guichou, Shili Wang Ting'e was appointed military governor of Longhua Prefecture.
idiomatic: On guichou day Shili Wang Ting'e was made military governor of Longhua Prefecture.

literal: On day yichou in the sixth month, the Tuhun came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On yichou day in the sixth month the Tuhun came with tribute.

literal: On day xinwei, he visited Pinbuli Marsh.
idiomatic: On xinwei day he visited Pinbuli Marsh.

literal: On day yimao in the seventh month of autumn, he hunted at South Red Mountain.
idiomatic: On yimao day in the seventh autumn month he hunted at South Red Mountain.

literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on day bingwu, he visited Hongfu Temple to feed monks on the Empress's behalf; seeing a painted image of Guanyin donated by the Great Sage Emperor, Empress Yingtian, and Renhuang Prince, he turned to those beside him and said, "In years not long past I gathered here with my parents and brothers to view this; now I come alone!
idiomatic: That winter, in the eleventh month, on bingwu day, he went to Hongfu Temple to feed monks for the Empress's sake; there he saw a painted image of Guanyin that the Great Sage Emperor, Empress Yingtian, and Renhuang Prince had donated. Turning to those beside him he said, "Not so many years ago my parents, my brothers, and I stood here together to look at this — and now I come alone!

literal: " He mourned and sighed without end.
idiomatic: " He wept and sighed without end.

literal: He then personally composed an inscription for the wall, giving fullest voice to his grief and longing.
idiomatic: Then he composed an inscription in his own hand and had it written on the wall, giving full expression to his grief.

literal: Those who read it were moved to sorrow.
idiomatic: All who read it were moved to tears.

literal: On day gengchen in the twelfth month, he went to Jinping Marsh and dispatched Zhaila Huage, Kululi, Arusuogu, and others to capture livestock in enemy territory.
idiomatic: On gengchen day in the twelfth month he went to Jinping Marsh and sent Zhaila Huage, Kululi, Arusuogu, and others to raid enemy lands for livestock.

literal: The eleventh year of Tianxian.
idiomatic: The eleventh year of Tianxian.

literal: In the first month of spring in the eleventh year, he went ice fishing on the Tu River.
idiomatic: In the eleventh year, in the first spring month, he went ice fishing on the Tu River.

literal: On day gengshen, he went to the Huang River.
idiomatic: On gengshen day he went to the Huang River.

literal: On the gengyin new moon of the third month, the Jurchen came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On the gengyin new moon of the third month the Jurchen brought tribute.
